Ferrite Simulator

Ferrite Simulator

RT-950 Pro · 240 × 320 screen

The firmware's own screen code, running on a fake radio in your browser. Press the keys, tune the knob, open any screen from the list, and leave a comment on this page with what you'd change. Say which screen you were on; the copy button gives you its name.

Jump to a screen

    Opens the screen from home, so BACK returns home. Codes are the manual's screen numbers.

    Make something happen

    End tone preview

    The tone sent as you let go of PTT (MENU 0 8 4, or per channel). Press one to hear it as the spec defines it; the firmware doesn't play these yet.

    Test tone

    A steady tone from this computer's speaker, for bench checks with the radio's mic held near it (the PA0 capture). Plays until you stop it.

    View

    Size

    Saved in this browser

    The radio keeps its settings, slots, channels and zones in flash, as the real one does. Here that flash is saved in your browser, so your changes are still there next time.

    Keyboard

    0–9
    Digits (hold on home for shortcuts)
    Enter
    MENU / OK (hold for options)
    Esc
    BACK (hold for home)
    ↑ ↓ ← →
    Arrows
    , .
    * and #
    S V
    SLOT (A·B·C) and V/M
    Q W
    SIDE1 (PF1: monitor) and SIDE2 (PF2: scan; hold alone for the frequency counter)
    Space
    PTT A (hold to transmit on the active slot)
    [ ] or wheel
    Channel knob

    Click the radio first so it has the keyboard. Long press is 0.7 s, as on the radio. Click VOL to switch it off and on.

    Cable terminal

    The radio's programming cable as a VT100 terminal (manual chapter 37). Click below and press Enter: you get the banner, then Channels, Zones, Settings, Monitor and About. Arrows move, Enter edits, Esc goes back, ? is help. Changes show on the radio at once.
